name: ShowOps Agent
author: ShowOps
description: Outbound-only ShowOps monitoring agent for FPP.
instructions: Install: set FPP UI Level to Advanced/Developer if needed, then paste https://raw.githubusercontent.com/showops-io/fpp-plugin-showops-agent/main/pluginInfo.json into Plugin Manager. Supports FPP 7+. Configure via Plugins → ShowOps Configuration.
